name: ablation-scoring-checks
title: Add the deterministic scoring-checks layer: harness-owned acceptance + hidden-regression + diff-hygiene
description: The powered ablation scores PRIMARY completion as acceptance exit 0 AND an independent hidden-regression + diff-hygiene check pass, with acceptance scripts harness-owned, read-only, hash-checked, run against a clean checkout and NOT in the agent's editable workspace (anti-gaming). Build these deterministic, offline-unit-testable checks.
